status: frozen before any lr1e-3 training launch
purpose: Test whether the weak SmolVLM2 and InternVL3.5 transfer results come from carrying a low learning rate from the obsolete skip-KL recipe into the new Full-path-only objective.

evidence_before_freeze.diagnosis: The matched Full AttnRes controls themselves are nearly neutral, while generic RSM parameter magnitudes are much smaller than in successful Qwen runs. Learning-rate transfer is therefore tested before changing the RSM equation or adding capacity.

replicate_seeds_1_and_2_if: RSM is above the corresponding lr1e-3 Full AttnRes control
RSM improves at least 0.15 percentage points over the corresponding lr1e-3 Full AttnRes control
continuation_gate.failure_policy: Retain the result and diagnose one mechanism change; do not continue the current checkpoint or add an unbounded hyperparameter sweep.

material_passport.evaluation_data: local lmms-eval caches for the six formal VLM tasks
